added.description:
Description

At Cryptic Vector, we are dedicated to mission success. We take the time to understand our customers' needs, delivering products that perform when our nation needs them most. We understand that properly supporting the most unique missions of the United States government requires the nation’s best. Our focus is on creating a culture where the best and brightest want to grow, learn, and stay. If coming up with out-of-the-box solutions is your specialty, then you’ll feel right at home at Cryptic Vector. We are solving the country’s most unique problems in an environment where problem solvers and hard workers thrive. We've replaced corporate red tape with transparency and servant leadership. Honestly, it’s hard not to love this culture!

We value the individual experiences that our team members add to our culture and capabilities. Please don't hesitate to apply even if you don't meet the exact qualifications! We are interested in varying levels of experience.

Director of Engineering

We’re looking for an experienced, people-focused Director of Engineering to lead and scale our engineering organization. In this role, you’ll own engineering talent management, drive high-quality technical execution, and build the processes and culture that enable mission success. You’ll partner closely with Program Managers and Division Directors to ensure the right talent is in the right places while developing the next generation of technical leaders.

You’ll have the opportunity to shape how engineering operates across the company—establishing consistent standards, balancing resources across competing priorities, and fostering a culture of collaboration, technical excellence, and mission impact.

Responsibilities

Lead and manage the engineering organization
Own engineering talent management: hiring, development, mentoring, performance, and retention
Ensure the right engineering talent is assigned to programs, IRADs, and proposals
Establish consistent engineering processes, standards, tools, and best practices across locations and divisions
Drive engineering execution with a focus on quality, schedule, technical rigor, accountability, and follow-through
Identify skill and capability gaps and develop recruiting or training plans to address them
Develop technical leaders and create clear career paths for engineers
Balance engineering resources across competing program and business priorities
Partner with Program Managers and Division Directors to ensure programs have the technical resources needed to succeed
Own engineering metrics and organizational health (utilization, staffing, attrition, recruiting needs, skill mix, etc.)
Foster a strong engineering culture focused on collaboration, technical excellence, innovation, and mission impact

Requirements

Minimum Qualifications

10+ years of progressive engineering experience, including significant leadership experience
Proven track record of building, leading, and scaling high-performing engineering teams
Experience owning talent management processes (hiring, performance management, development, and retention)
Demonstrated ability to drive engineering execution against quality, schedule, and technical standards
Experience establishing engineering processes, standards, tools, and metrics
Strong ability to partner with program and business leadership in a matrixed environment
Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field
Active security clearance (or ability to obtain one) preferred depending on program needs

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s degree in a technical or related field
Experience leading multi-site or multi-division engineering organizations
Background in defense, intelligence, or government contracting environments
Experience with resource planning, capacity management, and organizational health metrics
Demonstrated success developing technical leaders and career frameworks
Strong communication skills with the ability to influence senior stakeholders

This role requires use of technical data subject to U.S. Government contract restrictions, therefore this posting is only for U.S. Citizens.

Cryptic Vector is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Location:

Medidata follows a hybrid office policy in which employees who are hired for an in-person position are expected to work on site a certain number of days per week following Company policy.

About our Company:

Medidata is powering smarter treatments and healthier people through digital solutions to support clinical trials. Celebrating over 25 years of ground-breaking technological innovation across more than 38,000 trials and 12 million patients, Medidata offers industry-leading expertise, analytics-powered insights, and one of the largest clinical trial data sets in the industry. More than 1 million registered users across approximately 2,300 customers trust Medidata's seamless, end-to-end platform to improve patient experiences, accelerate clinical breakthroughs, and bring therapies to market faster. A Dassault Systèmes brand (Euronext Paris: FR0014003TT8, DSY.PA), Medidata is headquartered in New York City and has been recognized as a Leader by Everest Group and IDC. Discover more at www.medidata.com. Listen to our latest podcast, from Dreamers to Disruptors, and follow us at @Medidata.

About the Team:

The Medidata Platform unifies the entire trial lifecycle, from design to closeout, in a single AI-driven ecosystem. The Medidata Platform gives every team a single connected foundation. It simplifies work for sites while giving sponsors and CROs greater oversight and predictability, lowering development costs, accelerating enrollment, and improving the patient experience.

Who you are:

You will report to the Senior Director of Software Engineering within the Platform team and collaborate with product, PMO and QA and your teams of engineers. You will build high quality products and tools relied upon by all internal engineering teams and customer-facing functions at Medidata. Our applications are built with a variety of technologies and hosted on AWS. As a Director, you'll be challenged both to develop new features in response to market demand and improve the performance and scalability of our applications to meet the growing user base, as well as define the technical vision for your areas of responsibility. You will also lead the engineering organization through the adoption of AI-augmented workflows and Spec-Driven Development (SDD), ensuring that technical strategies maximize efficiency and innovation.

Responsibilities:

You will lead multiple engineering teams spread globally
Keep your team unified, motivated and connected to the our goals
You will use your previous experience to help improve engineering processes
Handle ambiguities and guide data-driven, collaborative decision-making
You will lead your teams to turn the technical vision into reality by collaborating with architects and other teams
Maintain good awareness of software engineering best practices
Strategic Priority Balancing: Establish and maintain a rigorous operational framework that balances competing engineering demands. Prioritize 60% of effort on high-value feature delivery, 30% on deliberate architectural modernization and technical debt reduction, and 10% on operational efficiency to ensure long-term scalability

Competencies:

AI-Augmented Engineering & Ways of Working
Experience in driving organizational adoption of AI-augmented workflows, such as Spec-Driven Development (SDD)
Ability to balance autonomous agentic systems with human oversight, ensuring quality and alignment with business goals
Focus on data-driven decision-making, using metrics to measure AI ROI and productivity gains
Strong change management skills to foster a culture of experimentation and continuous improvement in an AI-first environment

Technical Leadership

Cloud-native architecture design with emphasis on scalability and reliability
Technical vision development and communication
DevOps practices and continuous delivery experience

Business Acumen

Strong understanding of software product development lifecycles
Experience with digital transformation strategies
Business outcomes-focused thinking

Leadership and Management

Proven track record of building and leading high-performing engineering teams
Ability to develop and implement organizational change initiatives
Strong communication and interpersonal skills

Innovation and Strategy

Ability to develop and execute technical strategies that align to business objectives
Experience with design thinking and user-centered design approaches
Ability to make data-driven decisions with metrics and KPIs
Fostering a culture of innovation and experimentation

Technical Modernization

Strategically assess and retire legacy technical debt. Lead the organization in refactoring monolithic systems into modern, cloud-native architectures that accelerate development velocity while maintaining strict security and compliance standards

Collaboration and Influence

Strong relationships with senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders
Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams (product, design, customer support, etc.)
Ability to influence technical direction without direct authority

added.description:
We take play seriously. We’re looking for curious adventurers ready to find their party, fueled by imagination and drive to build what’s never been built before. At Hasbro and Wizards of the Coast, you’ll collaborate with passionate teams to reimagine our iconic brands and create experiences that spark joy, connection, and community through the magic of play. This is your chance to shape legendary play that lasts a lifetime.

At Wizards of the Coast, we connect people around the world through play and imagination. From our genre-defining games like Magic: The Gathering® and Dungeons & Dragons® to our growing multiverse, we continue to innovate and build new ways to foster friendship and connection. That’s where you come in!

The Director of Cloud Infrastructure & Engineering leads Hasbro's critical infrastructure transformation: moving completely from on-premises data centers to AWS. This role also involves implementing cloud-native security to enable active detection and response. It is an enterprise-wide position supporting Hasbro and its studios, including Wizards of the Coast.

Reporting to the VP of Infrastructure Engineering and Operations, this is a senior leadership role. You will be responsible for Cloud Platform Engineering, Data Center Services, and Site Reliability Engineering. You will run the associated P&Ls and FinOps subject area. You will also lead the governance model for a rapidly growing AWS environment.

What You'll Do

Cloud Platform, Strategy & Reliability

Define and own the multi-year cloud strategy and roadmap. This includes target-state architecture and hybrid/multi-cloud posture. Establish cloud as an internal product with clear SLAs and a self-service, paved-road platform model.
Own the on-premises to AWS migration end to end, holding the organization accountable to achievements and business outcomes.
Own the retained data centers. Manage planning, contract posture, and daily operations through and beyond the migration. This ensures the hybrid estate runs as one platform, not two.
Lead a customer-first platform organization: develop secure, well-managed, modular elements built to accelerate studio and partner engineering teams,
Establish Site Reliability Engineering as a new field. Define the operating model and charter, then develop it: SLOs, error budgets, incident management, on-call maturity, and DR/BCP for cloud-hosted workloads.

Account Management & Oversight (in collaboration with Cybersecurity)

Own the development and day-to-day operation of the AWS multi-account structure, including organizational units, account vending, and Landing Zone/Control Tower guardrails, as accounts scale through the data center migration.
Define and enforce account lifecycle policies: provisioning, tagging standards, ownership assignment, decommissioning, and access review.
Maintain a governance framework aligned with the AWS Well-Architected Framework, focusing on the Cost Optimization and Security pillars. Audit accounts for drift and collaborate with your teams to address issues.
Own Service Control Policies, tagging enforcement, and account-level compliance reporting as a durable operating approach in this field, not a one-time cleanup.
Collaborate with the Hasbro Cybersecurity and Identity teams to strengthen cloud security posture across guardrails, CSPM, and Defender for Cloud, and advance the implementation of an active SIEM, including analytic rules, KQL detections, and automated response.
Partner with Network and Identity leadership to develop Zero Trust at the cloud edge, integrating user-based policy with cloud network controls.

FinOps & Cost Management

Own the cloud P&L, handling a multi-year program budget.
Establish and lead the FinOps operating rhythm: cost allocation, showback to business units and studio teams, forecasting, and variance reporting.
Be responsible for the lifecycle of commitment-based discounts, including coverage, utilization, and renewal strategy, to improve savings without over-committing.
Establish unit economics for cloud-hosted workloads (cost per environment, per service, per studio) so engineering and business collaborators can understand cost-to-value tradeoffs.
Identify and promote optimization opportunities such as rightsizing, idle resource cleanup, and architecture changes, in collaboration with studio and partner engineering teams.

Vendor & Collaboration Management

Own the AWS partner relationship: enterprise agreement terms, credits, support for blocking issues, and roadmap alignment.
Partner with Finance and Procurement on budget planning, invoice reconciliation, and true-up processes tied to the multi-year migration budget.
Act as the governance and cost point of contact for studio engineering teams.
Serve as the executive-facing owner of cloud, delivering VP reporting on account health, governance posture, and cost trends, with cross-functional roadmap alignment across Identity, Network, Cybersecurity, Finance, Central Tech, and studio engineering.

Team Developement

Build and develop a layer of cloud architects and subject-matter experts across cloud providers, governance, compliance, and security.
Build, mentor, and develop a management and principal engineer layer across Cloud Platform Engineering, Cloud Security Operations, and SRE or equivalent experience; own organizational structure, headcount, hiring, and performance.

What You'll Bring

10+ years of infrastructure and cloud engineering, with 5+ years leading teams, including experience managing managers.
A proven track record owning enterprise-scale AWS environments and delivering a large-scale data center to cloud migration end-to-end.
Deep AWS platform proficiency and demonstrated governance ownership at scale, across Landing Zone, Control Tower, multi-account structure and guardrails, tagging and policy enforcement, Well-Architected-aligned auditing, EKS, cloud networking, and AWS IAM Identity Center.
Demonstrated FinOps leadership, having owned a multi-million-dollar cloud budget and driven measurable unit-cost improvement.
Platform engineering leader with a customer-centered approach, having developed secure and well-controlled reusable components that noticeably improved the teams you assist, in an organization that puts internal customers' needs first rather than directing them.
Experience building and scaling engineering organizations. This includes composing org structure, hiring, and developing leaders below you. You will mature functions that did not previously exist. You have the executive presence to translate infrastructure risk and investment into business language at the VP level.
A security-forward approach, having partnered with cybersecurity and identity organizations to harden a cloud estate and operationalize detection and response.

NICE TO HAVE

AWS Solutions Architect Professional or DevOps Engineer Professional; FinOps Certified Professional.
Practical experience in implementing Microsoft Sentinel and Defender for Cloud.
Site Reliability Engineering organization expansion focusing on SLOs, error budgets, and on-call maturity.
Exposure to Zero Trust and SASE architectures and cloud access based on user verification.
Experience in a multi-studio, multi-BU entertainment or gaming enterprise environment.

Who are we?

At Finastra, we’re a global leader in financial services software, dedicated to expanding access to financial services and shaping what’s next for the industry. Our technology powers mission‑critical solutions across Lending, Payments and Universal Banking, supporting over 7,000 customers, including 80% of the world’s top 50 banks, in more than 110 countries.

What will you contribute?

Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer, you will lead the architecture, modernization, and scalability of Finastra's Lending technology platform. As the Head of Lending Architecture & Platform Engineering, you will define the technology vision and architectural strategy for Lending products, driving platform transformation, cloud adoption, AI enablement, and engineering excellence. This role combines strategic leadership with deep technical expertise to ensure the delivery of secure, scalable, and high-performing SaaS solutions that support business growth and innovation.

Responsibilities & Deliverables

Your deliverables as a Head of Lending Architecture & Platform Engineering will include, but are not limited to, the following:

Technology & Architecture Leadership

Define and own the overall architectural vision, technical strategy, and long-term scalability of the platform.
Establish and enforce architectural principles, patterns, and governance across lending engineering teams.
Drive modernization of legacy systems, including re-architecture, cloud migration, refactoring toward microservices or modular architectures.

Platform Engineering

Lead the development of shared platform services, frameworks, and tooling that support all product teams (e.g., identity, observability, CI/CD, logging, infrastructure as code).
Build and scale internal platforms that improve developer productivity, system performance, and operational efficiency.
Partner with central teams to enforce security, resilience, and compliance at the platform level.

AI Enablement

Collaborate with the chief AI officer team and lead the definition of the framework and patterns needed to operationalize AI models in Lending products
Establish architectural guardrails for model training, inference, explainability, and performance at scale.
Ensure AI components are standardized, secure, compliant, and cost effective across Lending products and environments (on-prem, cloud)
Drive the adoption of AI tech (eg CoPilot) within the engineering teams with the focus on enhancing productivity and time to market.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Collaborate closely with product engineering, infrastructure, security, and data teams to align technical architecture with business goals.
Serve as a technical thought partner translating product goals into robust technical solutions.
Participate in roadmap planning, capacity management, and cross-team architectural reviews.
Present architecture roadmaps and trade-offs to executive leadership and technical teams

Technology Operations & Governance

Support high-availability operations for products, shared services and platform capabilities.
Own key architectural decisions related to performance, reliability, observability, cost, and maintainability.

Team Management & Enablement

Hire, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of platform engineers and architects.
Foster a culture of technical excellence, innovation, and continuous learning.
Define team goals, OKRs, and performance metrics aligned with company objectives.

Required Experience

Proven software engineering experience and technical leadership or architecture roles.
Deep experience designing scalable, distributed systems and cloud-native architectures (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP).
Proven success leading platform or infrastructure teams supporting developer tools, shared services, or internal platforms.
Strong understanding of AI driven and modern application development practices (CI/CD, containers, microservices, IaC, observability).
Experience designing and scaling platforms that support AI use cases
Deep understanding of AI platforms, model lifecycle management, and AI compliance practices.

Familiarity with compliance and security requirements in cloud environments (e.g., SOC 2, GDPR, AML, KYC, etc).

Lead with Purpose, Unlock Your Team's Passion

At LPL, people leaders hold the key to the employee experience - shaping culture, driving performance, and guiding individuals to new heights. Because when that happens, we all win - clients, LPL, and most importantly our employees.

If you're ready to lead with intention and discover what's possible, LPL Financial invites you to apply today.

Generate Interest

LPL Financial is seeking a Vice President, Cloud Lead to help shape the future of our cloud technology ecosystem and drive the development of scalable, secure, and high-performing enterprise platforms. This role offers the opportunity to influence technology strategy, guide cloud transformation initiatives, and work closely with business and technology partners to deliver innovative solutions that support LPL's strategic objectives.

As a key technology leader, you will collaborate with Product, Architecture, Quality Engineering, Release Management, and Infrastructure teams to design and implement cloud-native and hybrid-cloud solutions. This role is ideal for someone passionate about modern software engineering, cloud architecture, platform scalability, and engineering excellence.

Job Overview

The Vice President, Cloud Lead is responsible for designing, developing, and supporting enterprise applications and platform services within cloud and hybrid-cloud environments. This role provides technical leadership across solution architecture, cloud engineering, application development, platform modernization, and software delivery. The position partners with business and technology stakeholders to ensure solutions align with enterprise standards, technology roadmaps, and business goals while maintaining scalability, security, and operational excellence.

Responsibilities

Lead the design and development of scalable enterprise applications and platform services within cloud and hybrid-cloud environments.
Partner with Product Management, Architecture, Quality Engineering, Release Management, and business stakeholders to deliver technology solutions aligned with strategic objectives.
Participate in all phases of the software development lifecycle, including design, development, testing, deployment, support, and ongoing enhancement.
Design solutions that align with enterprise architecture standards, security requirements, and cloud engineering best practices.
Develop and support highly scalable platform components, APIs, applications, and services that serve enterprise business needs.
Provide advanced troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and technical support for complex application and platform issues.
Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend architecture, process, and platform improvements to enhance performance, reliability, and scalability.
Contribute to solution planning, technical estimates, and roadmap development activities.
Maintain technical documentation and ensure solutions are properly documented throughout their lifecycle.
Mentor engineers and promote engineering excellence through knowledge sharing, technical guidance, and adoption of best practices.

What Are We Looking For?

We're looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast-paced, team-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates pursue greatness, act with integrity, and are driven to help our clients succeed. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we win together and create and share joy in our work.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
10+ years of experience in software development, application architecture, and enterprise technology delivery.
5+ years of experience designing and developing cloud or hybrid-cloud solutions.
5+ years of experience with full-stack application development utilizing technologies such as C#, Angular (or similar frameworks), and relational databases.
Hands-on experience designing, deploying, and supporting solutions on AWS cloud platforms.

Core Competencies

Expertise in cloud architecture and cloud-native application development.
Knowledge of microservices architecture, distributed systems, and modern application design patterns.
Understanding of DevSecOps methodologies, software delivery practices, and automation frameworks.
Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to influence technical direction and drive organizational change.
Experience mentoring, coaching, and developing engineering talent.
Knowledge of domain-driven design, test-driven development, and software quality practices.

Preferences

Cloud engineering or cloud architecture certifications.
Experience with AWS technologies including ECS, EKS, Fargate, VPC, S3, RDS, Aurora, DynamoDB, IAM, EC2, Lambda, and serverless architectures.
Experience with source control systems, CI/CD pipelines, build automation, and continuous delivery practices.
Experience developing API-driven, messaging, or event-streaming solutions utilizing technologies such as Apache Kafka or StreamSets.
Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, and Infrastructure-as-Code methodologies.

Pay Range:

$159,959.00 - $266,564.00

Actual base salary varies based on factors, including but not limited to, relevant skill, prior experience, education, base salary of internal peers, demonstrated performance, and geographic location. Additionally, LPL Total Rewards package is highly competitive, designed to support your success at work, at home, and at play – such as 401K matching, health benefits, employee stock options, paid time off, volunteer time off, and more. Your recruiter will be happy to discuss all that LPL has to offer!

Company Overview:

LPL Financial Holdings Inc. (Nasdaq: LPLA) is among the fastest growing wealth management firms in the U.S. As a leader in the financial advisor-mediated marketplace(6) , LPL supports over 32,000 financial advisors and the wealth management practices of approximately 1,100 financial institutions, servicing and custodying approximately $2.3 trillion in brokerage and advisory assets on behalf of approximately 8 million Americans. The firm provides a wide range of advisor affiliation models, investment solutions, fintech tools and practice management services, ensuring that advisors and institutions have the flexibility to choose the business model, services, and technology resources they need to run thriving businesses. For further information about LPL, please visit www.lpl.com.

At LPL, independence means that advisors and institution leaders have the freedom they deserve to choose the business model, services, and technology resources that allow them to run a thriving business. They have the flexibility to do business their way. And they have the freedom to manage their client relationships, because they know their clients best. Simply put, we take care of our advisors and institutions, so they can take care of their clients.

For further information about LPL, please visit www.lpl.com.

Join the LPL team and help us make a difference by turning life’s aspirations into financial realities. Please log in or create an account to apply to this position. Principals only. EOE.

Information on Interviews:

LPL will only communicate with a job applicant directly from an @lplfinancial.com
email address and will never conduct an interview online or in a chatroom forum. During an interview, LPL will not request any form of payment from the applicant, or information regarding an applicant’s bank or credit card. Should you have any questions regarding the application process, please contact LPL’s Human Resources Solutions Center at (855) 575-6947.

This is a highly technical leadership position for someone who has successfully built production LLM/agent systems, scaled engineering teams, and still enjoys being deeply involved in code and architecture.

Set technical direction for production LLM and agent systems
Build agentic systems involving tool use, planning, orchestration, evaluations, and reliability
Recruit, mentor, and develop a world-class AI engineering team
Hire and develop future engineering leaders
Remain hands-on with architecture, code reviews, and experiment design
Partner closely with founders on technical and product strategy
Help build multiple specialized AI engineering teams as the company scales

Must-Haves

7+ years of AI/ML engineering experience

Led an AI/ML team that shipped production LLM or AI agent systems

Built and scaled an engineering team of 10+

Deep hands-on experience with agentic AI architectures

Strong knowledge of tool use, planning, multi-agent orchestration, and evaluation frameworks

Still actively writes or reviews code

Ability to evaluate technical architecture and experiment design

Strong people leadership, mentoring, recruiting, and team-building skills

CS or related technical degree from a top-tier university

Clear and concise communicator

High-ownership, founder-style mindset

Must be based in or willing to relocate to San Francisco

Comfortable working onsite 5 days per week

Nice-to-Haves
Early-stage or high-growth B2B SaaS startup
experience

at a rapidly scaling startup and shape both technical architecture and product direction.

updated.title: Chief Data & Platform Officer
updated.description:
Chief Data & Platform Officer

Location:
Fully Remote (Company is based in Annapolis, MD)

About the Company:

The Company is a rapidly growing and technology-enabled marketing organization serving the multifamily housing industry. Through innovative technology, data, analytics, and digital marketing solutions, the Company partners with leading multifamily owners and operators to deliver measurable business results.

As the Company enters its next phase of growth, it is investing heavily in its technology ecosystem and seeking a strategic executive to lead its data, platform, and AI initiatives.
Position Overview

The Chief Data & Platform Officer will lead the Company's technology platforms, enterprise data strategy, systems integrations, analytics infrastructure, and AI initiatives.

This executive will build and optimize the technology ecosystem that enables the business to scale, improve operational efficiency, and deliver measurable client value.

This is not a traditional CTO or CIO role focused on IT infrastructure or cybersecurity. However, an understanding of cybersecurity, data privacy, and technology risk is required to help guide platform, data, and AI decisions.

The ideal candidate has built integrated data and platform ecosystems within a high-growth multifamily, PropTech, MarTech, or SaaS organization and has experience leading technology transformation.

Key Responsibilities

Platform Strategy

Own the strategy, roadmap, and governance for the Company's technology ecosystem, including HubSpot, Asana, website architecture, client portals, reporting tools, workflow automation, and other business platforms.
Evaluate new technologies, oversee technology vendors, and continuously optimize the technology stack.

Data & Integrations

Build a centralized enterprise database and establish a single source of truth for business and client data.
Lead enterprise systems integrations across CRM, websites, client portals, reporting platforms, and internal applications.
Ensure strong governance around data quality, security, accessibility, and architecture.

Analytics & AI

Improve marketing attribution, reporting, and business intelligence through Google Analytics, campaign data, and integrated reporting.
Develop and execute the Company's AI strategy, including AI agents, workflow automation, and client-facing solutions that improve efficiency and innovation.

Executive Leadership

Lead the Technology Operations department, overseeing platform administration, HubSpot operations, data, workflow automation, systems integration, and business intelligence.
Partner with executive leadership and cross-functional teams to align technology investments with strategic business goals.

Key Outcomes

Success in this role includes:

A fully developed HubSpot CMS and client onboarding portal
Clear ownership of all core technology platforms
A centralized enterprise database and trusted source of truth
Connected systems with reliable, automated data movement
Improved attribution, analytics, and client ROI reporting
AI-powered solutions that enhance operational efficiency and client experience
Strong governance of platform architecture, integrations, data quality and privacy, AI governance and technology vendors

Qualifications

10+ years of leadership experience in technology, data, platforms, systems architecture, or enterprise applications
Proven success building enterprise data infrastructure and integrated technology ecosystems
Strong understanding of AI, automation, and emerging technologies
Expertise in data architecture, systems integration, APIs, enterprise platforms, CRM technologies, analytics, and business intelligence
Experience leading enterprise Hubspot or comparable CRM and platform implementations, migrations, and integrations
Experience leading technical teams and large-scale technology initiatives
Working knowledge of cybersecurity principles, data privacy, and technology risk management

Preferred

Experience in the multifamily industry
PropTech, MarTech, or SaaS background
Experience integrating CRM, PMS, websites, portals, reporting platforms, and marketing technologies
Understanding of marketing technology, attribution, and customer analytics
Experience supporting a high-growth or investor-backed organization

Ideal Candidate

We're looking for a leader who has:

Built connected enterprise platforms and scalable data infrastructure
Integrated CRM, websites, portals, reporting, and business systems
Improved analytics, business intelligence, and marketing attribution
Built or implemented AI and automation solutions
Led technology transformation within a growing organization
Experience in multifamily, PropTech, MarTech, or a related technology environment

Compensation & Benefits

Competitive base salary
Annual performance bonus
Executive revenue/profit-sharing incentive
Comprehensive health and wellness benefits
Fully remote work environment

Why Join the Company?

This is a unique opportunity to shape the technology foundation of a rapidly growing organization. You'll lead the strategy behind the Company's platforms, data infrastructure, and AI initiatives while partnering directly with executive leadership to drive innovation, scalability, and measurable business impact.
